title: Ombudsman suspends Tayabas City vice mayor

blocks.text: The Office of the Ombudsman has suspended Tayabas City, Quezon Vice Mayor Rosauro Dalida for six months and one day without pay after finding him administratively liable for conduct prejudicial to the best interest of the service.
